rows.text: The issue reports a 'pot de départ pour l'ex-Premier secrétaire le 19 novembre', at which François Hollande gave the staff of rue de Solferino a last speech.

The issue reports that at the Conseil national of 25 November the report of the commission de récolement, approved by 159 votes (76 against, 2 abstentions), indicated that in the second round of the election of the Premier secrétaire Martine Aubry obtained 67 451 votes and Ségolène Royal 67 349.
